placing_order.initiate_order: Start choosing items for a new basket; not checkout. Explicit item additions use add_to_basket.
placing_order.add_to_basket: Request new items for the basket, including additions with missing choices. Answers to a pending choice use customize_confirmation.
placing_order.update_order: Change items, flavor, size, or quantity in an unplaced basket. Pending choice answers use customize_confirmation. Changes to an already placed order use order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation.
placing_order.delete_entry: Remove an item or reduce its quantity in an unplaced basket, including answers identifying the item to remove.
placing_order.check_order_cart: Ask to view the current basket, its total, summary or changed prices; not consent to checkout.
placing_order.reorder_or_repeat: Ask to repeat a past order; not an explicit addition of named menu items.
placing_order.order_scheduling: Ask to schedule this order for later. Store referral only, including during checkout; no scheduling action or slot collection.
placing_order.order_channels_and_modes: Ask about ordering channels, fulfillment modes, delivery fees or minimums; also select a fulfillment preference before checkout.
placing_order.special_requests: Request a non-catalog customization or special arrangement, including a new item conditional on it. Store referral only; no basket action or detail collection. Standard catalog choices stay add/update requests.
placing_order.how_to_order: Ask how to order; not a command to add items or begin checkout.
placing_order.insufficient_information_order: An ordering request whose intended operation is unclear. A known add, edit, removal or checkout keeps its specific route even when details are missing.
placing_order.order_payment: Ask about payment or retrieve, resend or retry payment for an existing order. Starting checkout or supplying an open checkout field uses order_confirmation.
placing_order.customize_confirmation: Supply a requested item, flavor, size or quantity for a pending basket choice. Continue that request; not a new addition. Removal target answers use delete_entry.
placing_order.payment_confirmation: Report having paid or ask whether payment succeeded. The claim is not proof; payment must be verified by the handler.
placing_order.order_confirmation: Start or resume checkout, finish ordering, answer an open checkout field, or confirm the quoted order. Address confirmation alone is not checkout consent.
placing_order.cancel_and_abort: Legacy label; use general/cancel_and_abort for stopping pending work. Placed-order cancellations use order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation.

order_enquiry.order_status_tracking: Ask for the status or tracking of an existing order or delivery; a read-only enquiry.
order_enquiry.missing_or_wrong_items: Report wrong, missing, damaged or melted items, or request a replacement. Store referral; explicit refunds or placed-order changes use refund_and_cancellation.
order_enquiry.refund_and_cancellation: Request a refund, cancel a placed order or change its items or quantities, including within a complaint. Store referral; no verified order or receipt is required.
order_enquiry.address_or_contact_update: Request an address/contact change for a placed order or ask staff to call a supplied contact. Store referral; no contact update or callback is performed.
order_enquiry.delivery_problems: Report a late, failed or disputed delivery, or trouble contacting its driver. Store referral without collecting investigation details.
order_enquiry.general_order_enquiry: General order, delivery or logistics support without a more specific enquiry topic.
order_enquiry.get_order_history: Ask to view or summarize past orders; a read-only enquiry, not a request to reorder.

menu_items.availability: Ask which menu items or flavors are offered or available; not a request to add them.
menu_items.recommendations: Ask for a recommendation, popular item or help choosing what to try.
menu_items.dietary_preferences: Ask about dietary suitability or options such as vegan, eggless, dairy-free or sugar-free. Explicit allergy questions use allergens.
menu_items.allergens: Ask about allergens, allergy safety or cross-contact; takes precedence over general dietary preferences.
menu_items.ingredients: Ask what an item contains or about its recipe or composition.
menu_items.nutrition: Ask about calories, nutrients or nutritional information; dietary labels use dietary_preferences.
menu_items.preparation: Ask how a menu item is made or prepared.
menu_items.pricing: Ask an item or size price, including a corrected item name after a price question. Mentioning quantity does not request a basket change.
menu_items.specialty_items: Ask about signature, premium or specialty menu items.
menu_items.explore_options: Ask to browse the menu, categories or available choices.
menu_items.pairings: Ask which items or flavors go well together.
menu_items.source_quality: Ask about ingredient sourcing, freshness or quality.
menu_items.flavor_profile: Ask how an item tastes, including texture or sweetness.
menu_items.portion_and_size: Ask about serving sizes, package contents, volume or weight; not choosing a size for a pending addition.

location_based.choose_delivery_address: Choose a saved address for delivery. Not confirmation of an already selected address or setting a default for future orders.
location_based.add_delivery_address: Supply or save a new typed delivery address, including partial address-field replies. Before checkout this is address management; an address requested by open checkout stays order_confirmation.
location_based.update_delivery_address: Correct or update a saved delivery address; not the address on a placed order.
location_based.existing_addresses: Ask to list or read saved delivery addresses without selecting or changing one.
location_based.delete_delivery_address: Ask to delete a saved delivery address. The handler directs the user to the app; this is not delivery selection.
location_based.set_default_delivery_address: Set a saved address as the default for future orders; not selecting an address for the current delivery.
location_based.verify_address_for_delivery: Ask whether delivery covers an area, address or pincode. Published delivery fees and minimums use placing_order/order_channels_and_modes.
location_based.confirm_delivery_address: Confirm the address in an open address-confirmation question, including after an information detour. Not checkout confirmation or a new address.
location_based.deny_delivery_address: Reject the address in an open address-confirmation question; not cancellation of the order.

information_about_the_cafe.location_and_hours: Ask for the cafe address, directions, map link or opening hours.
information_about_the_cafe.brand_story: Ask about the origin, history or story of the cafe or brand.
information_about_the_cafe.amenities: Ask about facilities or amenities such as seating, parking or Wi-Fi.
information_about_the_cafe.events_and_tours: Ask about cafe events, factory visits or tours.
information_about_the_cafe.team_and_policy: Ask about the team, founders, ownership, legal entity or company policies.
information_about_the_cafe.about_the_brand: Ask general questions about the company, brand, reviews or reputation, including Google ratings.

out_of_context.out_of_scope: A meaningful request unrelated to the cafe or its services; not a cafe question with missing facts.

insufficient_information.insufficient_information: The intended request is unclear and needs clarification. Missing execution details or unavailable facts alone do not make a known intent unclear.

general.greeting: A standalone greeting or opening salutation.
general.goodbye: A farewell or conversation ending; not cancellation of pending work.
general.thanks: An expression of gratitude; not consent to repeat an action.
general.small_talk: Casual social conversation without a substantive cafe request.
general.cancel_and_abort: Stop the current conversation task, not a placed order. An explicit placed-order cancellation uses order_enquiry/refund_and_cancellation. If a bare cancel could mean either the pending task or a placed order, this control lets the workflow clarify the target.
general.wait: Ask to pause existing work while keeping it pending. Not cancellation, scheduling for later or a new addition with a deferred choice.
